text.tspan: Upsampling a 9 kHz sine by 4: insert zeros, then low-pass

svg.text: 1. The original samples at 48 kHz, on the 9 kHz sine they came from
2. Three zeros inserted after each sample, at 192 kHz
3. After the low-pass and ×4: the samples in between are filled in
dashed: the 9 kHz sine · the output is shown shifted back by the filter's 47.5-sample delay
